article.title: Google gags its engineers and sells AI for war
article.author: Gary Wilson
article.content: The Pentagon sets the terms. OpenAI, Amazon, Microsoft, Oracle, Nvidia and Elon Musk’s SpaceX signed similar contracts this year. The post Google gags its engineers and sells AI for war appeared first on MR Online .
